args.head: fix/banker-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

`round_money` in src/money.py was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, which makes `test_half_even` pass (2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

CI on the branch (ci-0001, sha 08d3cd5986): passed.
